subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI should show compact run progress for long or multi-agent tasks

question: Should this Control UI progress surface wait for the canonical gateway session-activity contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127, or should maintainers approve a narrower UI-first progress strip using existing coarse signals?
rationale: Current main does not define the needed phase taxonomy or source of truth, and open PRs show that the API/UX boundary is still a product decision rather than a mechanical patch.

options.title: Route through session activity API
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 as the source-of-truth contract, then land the compact Control UI strip on top of it.

options.title: Approve a narrow UI-first strip
options.body: Allow Control UI to show only existing coarse status and last visible events while the fuller activity API remains pending.

options.title: Close as covered by the API issue
options.body: Move all remaining discussion to the canonical gateway activity issue if maintainers decide the UI request should not remain separately tracked.

recommendation.title: Route through session activity API
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 as the source-of-truth contract, then land the compact Control UI strip on top of it.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the live assignee for the canonical activity-contract issue and has recent gateway/protocol history.
